question: Which of the following gases emits red light when electricity is passed through it?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Neon gas emits a distinctive red-orange light when electricity is passed through it.
 
• Neon is widely used in neon signs, which are often used for advertising purposes.
 
• Neon is a noble gas and is chemically inert, which makes it safe for use in various applications.
 
• Neon was discovered in 1898 by the British chemists Sir William Ramsay and Morris W. Travers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Neon:**

 
 
• Neon is a chemical element with the symbol Ne and atomic number 10.
 
• It is a noble gas, which means it is colorless, odorless, and inert under standard conditions.
 
• Neon has a very low boiling point and is the fifth most abundant element in the universe.
 
• Neon lights are created by passing an electric current through a tube filled with neon gas, causing the gas to glow brightly.
 
 
 
• **Other Gases Mentioned:**
 
 
• **Hydrogen:** A colorless, odorless gas that is the lightest and most abundant element in the universe. It is highly flammable and is used in fuel cells and as a rocket propellant.
 
• **Argon:** A noble gas with the symbol Ar and atomic number 18. It is used in welding, incandescent light bulbs, and as a protective atmosphere for growing silicon and germanium crystals.
 
• **Helium:** A colorless, odorless, tasteless, non-toxic, inert, monatomic gas that heads the noble gas group in the periodic table. It is used in cryogenics, as a coolant for nuclear reactors, and in lighter-than-air balloons.
